answer: A proof-of-work bond makes every new identity pay to enter the reward queue. First it locks 15 tokens; a beacon assigns a task, and the agent signs its result. Three established peers compare it with the task record, while a rotating auditor checks a sample for copying. A match returns the bond and adds reputation; reused answers burn the stake and block linked accounts for 12 rounds. A farm of 400 fakes must tie up 6,000 tokens and fund 1,200 peer checks before earning. The marble ledger makes each false identity visible at its nadir, while a ripple of penalties reaches the farm.
